tour.buttonAria: Take a guided tour of this admin page

sidebar.title: Your admin navigation
sidebar.description: This sidebar is how you move around the admin area: dashboard, events, teams, rankings, news, shop and more. The section you are on is highlighted in green.

title.title: Welcome to the admin dashboard
title.description: This is your control center. The cards below give you a live read on members, teams, tournaments, scrims, news and revenue at a glance.

metrics.title: Live community metrics
metrics.description: Each card shows a key number plus a shortcut to manage that area. Total Members tracks signups, Total Teams links straight to Teams and Players, and the revenue card reflects shop and event income.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.description: Jump straight into the most common tasks (create news, create an event) without hunting through the menu. These mirror the primary buttons on each section page.

recentActivity.title: Recent admin activity
recentActivity.description: A running log of what other admins have done lately, so the team stays in sync and you can spot who changed what. Use View All Activities for the full history.

tabs.title: Events and Leaderboards
tabs.description: This one page holds two tabs. Events is where you run tournaments and scrims; Leaderboards is where you publish standings. We will walk the Events tab first, then switch you to Leaderboards. The cards below the header read out your whole calendar: total events split into tournaments and scrims, how many are upcoming, ongoing or completed, the average participants per event, and your most popular format.

create.title: Create a new event
create.description: Start a tournament or scrim here. The wizard walks you through details, stages, prizes and rules, then publishes it. After creating it, you manage it from the list below.

payments.title: Event payments
payments.description: For paid events, this opens the escrow dashboard where you release or refund registration fees that Stripe is holding. Only paid events appear there.

search.title: Find an event fast
search.description: Filter the list below by event name, type (tournament or scrim) or status. Handy once you have a lot of events on record.

list.title: Your events and scrims
list.description: Every event lives here. Per row: View opens the full event detail (which has its own tabs including Overview, Registrations, Stages and Group Rosters), Edit reopens the wizard, and the trash icon deletes it. A small lock icon marks a private event.

switchToLeaderboards.title: Now the Leaderboards tab
switchToLeaderboards.description: That covers Events. Click Next and we will switch you to the Leaderboards tab, where you turn raw match results into published standings.

lbStats.title: Leaderboard totals
lbStats.description: These cards count your leaderboards overall and split them into tournament versus scrim leaderboards, so you can see what has been scored and what is still outstanding.

lbSearch.title: Pick an event to score
lbSearch.description: Search your events here, then use the table below it. Each row is an event you can attach or update a leaderboard for.

lbTable.title: View or edit a leaderboard
lbTable.description: For each event, View opens its current standings and Edit lets you enter or correct placements and kill points. This is where the public ranking for that event comes from.

tabs.title: Teams and Players
tabs.description: This one page combines two tabs. Teams manages registered squads and their tiers; Players manages individual accounts. We will walk Teams first, then switch you to Players.

rank.title: Rank teams into tiers
rank.description: Run the tiering pass that sorts teams into Tier 1, 2 and 3 from their performance. Use it after results are in. For the full quarterly tier lock and scoring, use the Rankings section in the sidebar.

search.title: Search and filter teams
search.description: Look up a team by name, or narrow the list to a single tier. The table below updates as you type.

list.title: The team roster
list.description: Every registered team, with its tier, member count, total wins and earnings. The row actions let you View a team or ban and unban it. Below this table you will also find Ghost Teams, the provisional placeholder squads that hold tournament results until a real team claims them.

switchToPlayers.title: Now the Players tab
switchToPlayers.description: That covers Teams. Click Next and we will switch you to the Players tab, where you manage individual player accounts.

playersCreate.title: Create a ghost player
playersCreate.description: Spin up a provisional player (a parked in-game name) that can be attached to a ghost team and claimed later. Useful for seeding results before a real account exists.

playersStats.title: Player stats at a glance
playersStats.description: These cards show total, active and banned players, average kills, and your top MVP and top wins players. A quick read on the health of the player base.

playersSearch.title: Search and filter players
playersSearch.description: Find a player by name, or filter by their team (including No Team) and by status (active or banned). The table below updates as you change these.

playersList.title: The players table
playersList.description: Every player with their team, kills, wins, MVPs and status. View opens that player's profile; the Ban or Unban button controls their platform access.

switchToReports.title: Now the Reports tab
switchToReports.description: That covers Teams and Players. Click Next and we will open the Reports tab, where you triage player and team reports filed by the community.

reportsStats.title: Report counts at a glance
reportsStats.description: These cards show the total reports filed and how many subjects are repeat offenders (3 or more reports on the same player or team within 2 weeks).

reportsFilters.title: Filter and search reports
reportsFilters.description: Narrow the queue by subject (player or team), status or category, search by reported name or reporter, or show only repeat offenders.

reportsTable.title: Review and answer reports
reportsTable.description: Each report shows who was reported, by whom, the reason, the proof image and its status. Click Answer to read the evidence and write a response the reporter sees on their profile.

header.title: The Rankings workspace
header.description: Rankings has its own row of sub-pages along the top: Overview (here), Scoring Config, Tournament Tiers, Result Markers, Seasons, Ghost Teams, Social, Prize, Overrides and Audit. This Overview is the control room; the others are where you set the rules and the raw data.

season.title: Pick the season
season.description: Everything on this page is scoped to one season. Switch seasons here; the team scores, tier distribution and publish state below all follow the season you pick.

status.title: Season status at a glance
status.description: These cards show the current season, whether the transfer window is open or locked, whether a recalculation is running, and when the last quarterly evaluation was run and by whom.

evaluation.title: Run the quarterly evaluation
evaluation.description: This locks every team and player tier for the next quarter from the current scores. Preview it first (a dry run that writes nothing), then commit. You can also queue a recalculation for a single team or player here. Head Admin or Metrics Admin only.

distribution.title: Tier distribution
distribution.description: A live breakdown of how many teams sit in each tier for this season. The badge flags any teams below the activity floor, which can affect their eligibility.

publish.title: Publish to the public
publish.description: The public rankings and tier badges stay hidden until you publish them, and the two surfaces are controlled separately. Publish one without the other, each with a logged reason.

quicklinks.title: Jump to the detail pages
quicklinks.description: These cards open the deeper Rankings tools: Result Markers (winners, finals and MVP flags), Seasons (dates and the transfer window), Ghost Teams (create placeholder squads and handle claims), and the Audit Log (every edit to the raw data). Scoring Config and Tournament Tiers sit in the sub-nav above.

teams.title: The team score table
teams.description: Every team's rank, tier, tournaments played, kills and total score for the season. Search it on the right, and use Edit markers on a row to jump to Result Markers for that team. This is the draft view, so you see the computed scores even before they are published.

title.title: Player Market administration
title.description: Oversight for the transfer market: team listings, player listings, trials and reports all live on this one page.

tabs.title: Move between market sections
tabs.description: Overview shows the headline numbers. The other tabs drill into Team Listings, Player Listings, Trials and Applications, and Reports and Flags. Open a tab to act on the items inside it.

overview.title: Market at a glance
overview.description: These cards summarise active listings, ongoing trials and pending reports, so you can spot anything that needs attention before opening the detail tabs.

header.title: The Rankings workspace
header.description: Rankings has its own row of sub-pages along the top: Overview here, Scoring Config, Tournament Tiers, Result Markers, Seasons, Ghost Teams, Social, Prize, Overrides and Audit. This Overview is the control room where you set the rules and manage the raw data.

season.title: Pick the season
season.description: Everything on this page is scoped to one season. Switch seasons here. The team scores, tier distribution and publish state below all follow the season you pick.

status.title: Season status at a glance
status.description: These cards show the current season, whether the transfer window is open or locked, whether a recalculation is running, and when the last quarterly evaluation was run and by whom.

evaluation.title: Run the quarterly evaluation
evaluation.description: This locks every team and player tier for the next quarter from the current scores. Preview it first as a dry run that writes nothing, then commit. You can also queue a recalculation for a single team or player here. Head Admin or Metrics Admin only.

distribution.title: Tier distribution
distribution.description: A live breakdown of how many teams sit in each tier for this season. The badge flags any teams below the activity floor, which can affect their eligibility.

publish.title: Publish to the public
publish.description: The public rankings and tier badges stay hidden until you publish them. The two surfaces are controlled separately. Publish one without the other, each with a logged reason.

title.title: Scoring Configuration page
title.description: The weights, brackets and thresholds that drive every ranking and tier calculation. Changes are versioned and automatically recalculate scores across the season.

version.title: Active config version
version.description: Shows whether the current configuration is the spec defaults or a versioned snapshot. When you save, a new version is drafted.

unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.description: Count of fields that differ from the saved version. Orange highlights mark changed fields as you edit them.

scales.title: Scoring brackets
scales.description: Edit the compression scales for kills, placement, prize money and social media. Open-ended brackets (the last row in each table) have no upper bound.

reset.title: Reset to spec defaults
reset.description: Load the specification defaults from the codebase. Stages them locally in the editor without persisting. Save to draft them as a new version.

save.title: Save changes
save.description: Draft a new immutable config version and queue a full recalculation for every ranked team and player. Unsaved field count shown on the button.

title.title: Tournament Tiers classification
title.description: Build a prioritised list of rules that classify tournaments into tiers. A tournament is evaluated top-down, the first rule it matches sets its tier.

stats.title: Rule count
stats.description: Shows how many rules are currently enabled. Disabled rules are kept but do not participate in classification.

rules.title: Tier rules
rules.description: Drag to reorder rules by priority. The first rule a tournament matches sets its tier (1 = 2.0x multiplier, 2 = 1.5x, 3 = 1.0x).

add.title: Add a new rule
add.description: Create a new classification rule. Set its conditions, tier, and whether it must match all or any of the conditions.

test.title: Test a tournament
test.description: Enter a tournament's prize, team count and player count to see which rule it matches and what tier it would be classified into.

save.title: Save all changes
save.description: Persist all rule changes. The audit trail logs which rules were created, updated, deleted or reordered.

title.title: Result Markers control
title.description: Enable or disable whether tournament results count toward rankings. Toggle counting for whole events or exclude specific teams and players.

status.title: Results status
status.description: Cards show the total tournaments, how many are fully counting, partially gated or disabled. Quick snapshot of which events feed the rankings.

search.title: Find an event
search.description: Filter tournaments by name, tier or status. Helps you quickly locate events that need adjustment.

list.title: Tournament list
list.description: Every tournament's counting status. Click to drill into exclusions for specific teams and players in that event.

flags.title: Counting flags
flags.description: Toggle whether winners, placement points and kills count for an entire tournament. Turn off to stop seeding results before the event is official.

exclusions.title: Team and player exclusions
exclusions.description: Exclude a specific team or player from counting in an event (for example due to rule violations). Exclusions are reason-gated and logged.

title.title: Seasons management
title.description: Define competition seasons, set quarter and year, open and close the transfer window, and run the quarterly tier evaluation.

create.title: Create a new season
create.description: Start a new quarter. Set the season name, quarter, year, start and end dates. This becomes the active season once created.

list.title: All seasons table
list.description: Every season, its quarter and year, date range, transfer window status and evaluation history. Click Edit to change dates or reopen the transfer window.

transfer.title: Transfer window
transfer.description: Open or close the transfer window (when teams can swap players). The window is independent from the season dates.

evaluation.title: Tier evaluation
evaluation.description: Each season shows when its quarterly evaluation ran and who ran it. Evaluation locks team and player tiers for the next quarter.

log.title: Transfer window log
log.description: Audit trail of every time the transfer window was opened, closed or extended. Shows who made the change and their reason.

title.title: Ghost Teams creation
title.description: Create placeholder squads to hold tournament results before a real team claims them. Seed the provisional roster with in-game names.

stats.title: Ghost team counts
stats.description: Cards show total unclaimed ghosts, those with pending claims, and claimed ghosts. Quick summary of the seeding pipeline.

create.title: Create a new ghost
create.description: Define a placeholder team with a roster of in-game names. The ghost holds results until a real team claims it.

tabs.title: Filter by status
tabs.description: Switch tabs to see all ghosts or just those with pending claims. Helps you spot work that needs approving.

list.title: Ghost teams table
list.description: All ghosts sorted by claim status. Unclaimed are available to seed results, pending shows claims in flight, claimed are retired.

claim.title: Approve or revoke claims
claim.description: When a team tries to claim a ghost, approve to lock the claim or revoke if it was fraudulent. Both actions are reason-logged.

title.title: Social media verification
title.description: Teams connect their Instagram and TikTok handles from their dashboard. You verify the combined follower count, which awards points per the bracket scale.

search.title: Find a team
search.description: Filter the list by team name. Shows connected and unconnected teams, making it easy to spot who still needs to link their handles.

list.title: Connected teams
list.description: Every team that has connected handles, their follower counts on each platform, combined total, and verification status.

verify.title: Verify follower counts
verify.description: Confirm a team's combined followers and lock them in. The bracket scale maps followers to points (capped at 10). Unverify to edit counts again.

correction.title: Correct follower counts
correction.description: Edit Instagram and TikTok follower numbers if they are out of date. Once saved, verify to lock them in and award points.

brackets.title: Points scale preview
brackets.description: Shows how combined followers map to points per tier. Points are computed live as you edit, then persisted when you verify.

title.title: Prize money tracking
title.description: Record prize payouts to teams for each tournament. The quarterly total maps to points on a bracket scale that builds tier scores.

total.title: Season total
total.description: Card shows the sum of all prize money recorded for the active season. Helps you verify you have captured all payouts.

add.title: Record a payout
add.description: Create a new prize entry. Pick the tournament, the team, and the NGN amount. A mandatory reason is logged for audit.

search.title: Find a payout
search.description: Filter by event or team name. Helps you locate a specific prize to edit or correct.

list.title: Prize payouts table
list.description: All recorded prizes scoped to the season. Shows event name, team, amount in NGN and when awarded. Edit or delete with reasons.

scale.title: Prize bracket scale
scale.description: Shows how quarterly prize money totals map to points. The scale is tied to the scoring configuration's prize brackets.

title.title: Manual tier and score overrides
title.description: Override a team or player's calculated tier, deduct points as a penalty, or ban-zero them for the season. All actions are reason-logged.

search.title: Find team or player
search.description: Search by name to locate the entity you want to override. The table updates as you type.

list.title: Teams and players table
list.description: All ranked entities with their computed score and tier, plus flags for overrides and penalties. Click a row to override tier or deduct points.

tier.title: Override tier
tier.description: Manually set a team's tier. The override persists until you change it. Useful when the computed tier does not match rule enforcement.

deduct.title: Deduct points
deduct.description: Subtract a specific number of points as a partial penalty. The team stays ranked but with reduced score. Unlike a ban-zero, the team is not hidden.

ban.title: Ban or zero out
ban.description: Remove a team or player from the rankings entirely for the season. A ban-zero sets their score to 0 and is visible in the audit log.

title.title: Audit log
title.description: Complete record of every edit to the rankings system. Filters by action type, date range and reason. Includes raw data breakdowns per team and player.

filters.title: Filter by type and date
filters.description: Narrow the log by action type (tournament result, prize, override, etc.) and date range. The reason search happens on the visible results.

search.title: Search by reason
search.description: Free-text search through the reason field on the fetched audit entries. Helps you find the change you are looking for.

list.title: Audit entries
list.description: Chronological log of every action. Shows type, reason, who made the change and when. Click to see before and after snapshots.

details.title: Before and after
details.description: When you click an audit entry, see the JSON before and after snapshots. Helps you understand what changed and verify it was intentional.

raw.title: Raw data breakdown
raw.description: Pull the raw score breakdown for any team or player. Shows how their final score is composed from tournament, scrim, prize and social components.

ordersCard.title: Your Orders Card
ordersCard.description: Quick access to the order tracker. Links directly to the Orders page to see all shop orders and their statuses.

vendorsCard.title: Manage Vendors
vendorsCard.description: Access vendor management. Grant selling access to users, suspend or reactivate vendors, and assign products to them.

approvalsCard.title: Product Approvals
approvalsCard.description: Review vendor-submitted products in the approval queue. Approve to publish or reject with feedback for improvement.

ordersFilter.title: Orders Time Filter
ordersFilter.description: Toggle between day, week, or month views of recent orders. The table below updates with orders from the selected period.

ordersTable.title: Recent Orders Table
ordersTable.description: Live orders from your store filtered by the selected time range. Shows order ID, customer, status, date and total amount.

stockStatus.title: Current Stock Status
stockStatus.description: Snapshot of virtual diamond inventory across variants. Color-coded badges show stock levels and a link opens full inventory management.

statsCards.title: Coupon Metrics Cards
statsCards.description: Summarize coupon performance with total count, active count, total redemptions, total savings and conversion rates across all coupons.

tabs.title: Metrics Tabs
tabs.description: Switch between Performance (ranked coupons by usage), Trends (monthly redemption trends), and Recent Activity (latest coupon usage).

performanceTable.title: Coupons Table
performanceTable.description: All coupons ranked by usage count. Shows code, discount type and value, status, usage count and a progress bar showing max usage capacity.

pagination.title: Pagination Controls
pagination.description: Navigate through pages of coupons when the list is long. Includes next, previous and direct page selection.

couponLink.title: View Coupon Details
couponLink.description: Click any coupon code to view its full details, history, redemption stats and edit settings like discount value or date range.

addProduct.title: Add Product Button
addProduct.description: Create a new product listing. Opens a modal to enter product name, category, variants with prices and stock quantities.

manageCategories.title: Manage Categories
manageCategories.description: Create, edit or delete product categories that organize your shop catalog and appear as tabs for customers browsing.

couponLink.title: Coupon Metrics Link
couponLink.description: Jump to the Coupon Metrics page to monitor coupon redemptions, savings and performance trends.

statusFilter.title: Product Status Filter
statusFilter.description: Filter products by status: All, Active, or Inactive. The products table updates instantly as you select a filter.

productsTable.title: Products Table
productsTable.description: Lists all products with name, type, category, stock level, price range, status and last update date. Includes row actions to edit or delete.

couponsSection.title: Coupons Management
couponsSection.description: Create new coupons or manage existing ones. Shows active and archived coupons with usage tracking and status controls.

search.title: Order Search
search.description: Find orders quickly by order ID, customer name, product name or user ID. Results update as you type.

statusTabs.title: Status Filter Tabs
statusTabs.description: Filter orders by status: All, Pending, or Paid. Tabs show counts for each status so you can spot pending orders that need attention.

table.title: Orders List
table.description: All orders with ID, customer, items purchased, status badge, date and total. Each row has a menu to view full details.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Navigate through pages of orders when the full list is large. Page numbers appear when needed.

viewDetails.title: View Order Details
viewDetails.description: Click View Details on any order to see the full breakdown: items, quantities, prices, discounts and customer shipping information.

add.title: Add Vendor
add.description: Grant marketplace selling access to an existing user. Enter their email or user ID and set up their vendor profile with display name and contact details.

assignProduct.title: Assign Product to Vendor
assignProduct.description: Reassign a product to a different vendor or clear it back to first-party AFC stock. Pick the product and target vendor from dropdowns.

table.title: Vendors List
table.description: All vendors with display name, contact email, WhatsApp number, status, product count and registration date. Status toggles let you suspend or reactivate instantly.

statusToggle.title: Vendor Status Toggle
statusToggle.description: Suspend an active vendor to revoke their selling access or reactivate a suspended vendor to let them sell again.

contactInfo.title: Vendor Contact Details
contactInfo.description: Each vendor row shows their contact email and WhatsApp number for support coordination and fulfillment communication.

queueTable.title: Approval Queue
queueTable.description: All vendor-submitted products waiting for review. Shows product name, vendor, price range, variant count and submission date for quick assessment.

approveButton.title: Approve Product
approveButton.description: Publish a vendor product to the storefront. Once approved, the product status changes and it can be offered for sale.

rejectButton.title: Reject Product
rejectButton.description: Send a product back to the vendor with feedback. Opens a dialog to enter a rejection reason the vendor can see and act on.

rejectReason.title: Rejection Reason Input
rejectReason.description: Write clear feedback for the vendor explaining why their product was rejected, for example pricing issues or missing details.

emptyState.title: Queue Empty State
emptyState.description: When there are no submitted products, the queue shows an empty state. Products appear here when vendors submit new listings.

tabs.title: Events and Leaderboards tabs
tabs.description: Switch between the Events tab (manage tournaments and scrims) and Leaderboards tab (publish standings). The tour walks both tabs.

create.title: Create a new event
create.description: Start a tournament or scrim. The wizard walks you through details, stages, prizes and rules, then publishes it.

payments.title: Event payments dashboard
payments.description: For paid events, manage the escrow where you release or refund registration fees that Stripe is holding.

search.title: Find an event fast
search.description: Filter the list below by event name, type (tournament or scrim) or status. Handy once you have many events on record.

list.title: Your events and scrims
list.description: Every event lives here. Per row: View opens the full event detail, Edit reopens the wizard, and the trash icon deletes it.

lbStats.title: Leaderboard totals
lbStats.description: Cards count your leaderboards overall and split them into tournament versus scrim leaderboards, so you can see what has been scored.

title.title: Create new event
title.description: Multi-step wizard to build a tournament or scrim from scratch. Follow the steps through details, stages, prizes and rules.

nextButton.title: Step navigation
nextButton.description: Click Next or Previous to move through the event creation wizard.

save.title: Create event button
save.description: When you reach the final step, click Create Event to save and publish your tournament or scrim.

title.title: Event payments escrow
title.description: Registration fees for paid events are held in escrow. Release funds to the organizer or refund the player here.

filter.title: Filter by event
filter.description: Select a specific paid event to see its held payments, or view all payments across all paid events.

summary.title: Payment summary cards
summary.description: See the count of total payments, how many are held in escrow awaiting action, and how many are displayed with your current filter.

table.title: Payments table
table.description: Per payment row: view the event, payer, team, amount, status and escrow state. Held payments show Release and Refund action buttons.

title.title: Event detail page
title.description: Single event management hub. View or edit all aspects: overview, registrations, stages, teams and prizes.

overview.title: Overview tab
overview.description: Live snapshot of the event: total registered, countdown to start, prizepool and distribution.

details.title: Details tab
details.description: Event meta: name, type, mode, dates, rules, restrictions, sponsors and waitlist config.

registrations.title: Registrations tab
registrations.description: Who has signed up. View the timeline of registrations, filter by status, download the roster and manage invites for private events.

stages.title: Stages tab
stages.description: Tournament bracket structure. See each stage, its groups, teams, and match count. Seed live events or edit stage and group config here.

groupRosters.title: Group Rosters tab
groupRosters.description: Live-event seeding check: who is where in which group. Search by player or team name for fast lookup during the event.

title.title: Edit event
title.description: Reopen the event wizard to change any detail, stage, or rule after creation.

basic.title: Basic info tab
basic.description: Event name, type, mode, dates, registration dates and links, public or private status.

stages.title: Stages and groups tab
stages.description: Modify stage count, dates, formats, group counts, qualifying teams and prize pools.

prizes.title: Prize and rules tab
prizes.description: Manage prizepool amounts, distribution by placement, and event rules text or upload.

actions.title: Actions tab
actions.description: Publish to tournaments or news, or save as draft. Control who can register and manage sponsor and waitlist settings.

title.title: OCR screenshot extraction
title.description: Upload a match result screenshot and auto-extract player names, kills and placements. Review and correct before saving.

upload.title: Upload screenshot
upload.description: Drop or select a match result screenshot image. The OCR engine scans it for player stats.

review.title: Review extracted data
review.description: OCR output appears as a table. Check each row for accuracy and manually fix any misreads before committing.

commit.title: Commit OCR data
commit.description: Save the reviewed OCR rows to this event. They become part of the match result.

title.title: Event sponsor management
title.description: List competitors by whether they met sponsor requirements. Search, filter by status and verify or reject submissions.

filter.title: Filter by status
filter.description: Show all competitors, only those who passed sponsor verification, or only those who failed.

table.title: Competitors table
table.description: Per row: competitor name, their UUID or identifier, submission date and status. Use the actions to verify or reject each one.

verify.title: Verify or reject submission
verify.description: Per row: click Verify to accept a sponsor requirement, or Reject if it did not meet the criteria.

title.title: Create leaderboard
title.description: Multi-step wizard to generate standings for a tournament or scrim. Pick the event, stage and group, then enter or upload results.

basic.title: Basic information step
basic.description: Select the event, stage and group to score. The form shows the available stages and groups from that event.

scoring.title: Point system step
scoring.description: Set kill points, assist points and damage points. Choose whether the same point values apply to all maps or vary per match.

matches.title: Match results step
matches.description: Enter match results by hand, upload a screenshot for OCR extraction, or upload a 3D room file. One option per match.

review.title: Review and publish step
review.description: See the final leaderboard standings, then publish them to make this group's results live for the public.

title.title: Leaderboard standings
title.description: View final standings for a group. See placements, kill counts and total points for every competitor.

stageGroup.title: Stage and group picker
stageGroup.description: Dropdown selectors to view standings for different stages and groups in this event.

table.title: Standings table
table.description: Per competitor row: placement, name, kill count, assists, damage and total points.

matchPicker.title: Match selector
matchPicker.description: Choose Overall leaderboard or drill into a single match to see placement and points for that match only.

download.title: Download leaderboard
download.description: Export the standings as a CSV or Excel file for sharing with organizers or the public.

title.title: Edit leaderboard
title.description: Correct or re-enter match results for a published leaderboard. Update points, placements and kill counts per match.

stageGroup.title: Stage and group picker
stageGroup.description: Choose which stage and group's matches you want to re-edit.

matchList.title: Match list
matchList.description: See all matches in the selected group. Click a match to open the edit view for that match's results.

match.title: Edit individual match
match.description: Re-enter or upload match results. Choose manual entry, screenshot OCR, or 3D room file upload.

save.title: Save changes
save.description: When done editing match results, click Save to update the published leaderboard.

mvpTab.title: Event MVPs
mvpTab.description: An MVP is decided for EVERY map by your arranged criteria (kills, damage, assists, and the 3D-room stats once ingested); the event MVP is the player with the most map MVPs. Pick whether MVPs come from the overall event or the winning team of each map.

tieBreakers.title: Tie-breakers (Scoring Config tab)
tieBreakers.description: When teams finish level on points, this arrangement breaks the tie: booyahs, kills, placement points, even Map MVPs won. Like maps, it can apply to the whole event or be overridden per stage or per group.

debuggerBackfill.title: Debugger log backfill (Upload tab)
debuggerBackfill.description: Upload the observer PC's debugger-*.log to add deaths, knockdowns, headshots, revives and survival time to matches AFTER the fact. Map each detected round to its match and apply - players are matched by their Free Fire UID, and the 3D-room MVP criteria unlock automatically.

capture.title: AFC Capture software
capture.description: Download the desktop app that runs on the room-hosting PC. It auto-uploads each round's result and pushes live in-round standings to your overlays.

events.title: Pick an event
events.description: Every event is listed here. Open one to manage ALL of its overlays: designs with live previews, the countdown timer scene, the broadcast control and the capture key.

newOverlay.title: Create an overlay
newOverlay.description: Make a new overlay from any leaderboard design, or add a countdown timer scene. Each overlay gets ONE permanent link you add to OBS/vMix once.

cards.title: Your saved overlays
cards.description: Each card is one overlay with a LIVE preview of its real link. Change its design, stage or group, animations, or trigger the timer - the same link updates in OBS by itself. Rename, duplicate or delete from the card.

broadcast.title: Broadcast control
broadcast.description: Overlays set to 'Follow the broadcast selection' show whatever you pick here - switch the live stage or group without touching OBS.

create.title: Create a new organization
create.description: Spin up a new organization with owner assignment. The form requires a name and owner username to get started.

search.title: Search organizations
search.description: Filter the organization list by name or slug. Results update as you type.

subnav.title: Organization sections
subnav.description: Switch between Organizations list, Design Requests, and Org Reports using the sub-navigation tabs.

table.title: Organizations table
table.description: Every registered organization with status, member count, events, and creation date. Click a name to view or edit its details.

pagination.title: Navigate organization pages
pagination.description: Move through the organization list using page numbers. The table is paginated server-side for performance.

title.title: Organization integrity reports
title.description: A queue for user-submitted reports against organizations regarding rankings manipulation, fake results, or unfair conduct.

subnav.title: Switch between organization sections
subnav.description: Navigate Organizations list, Design Requests, and Org Reports via this sub-nav.

statusFilter.title: Filter reports by status
statusFilter.description: Show reports by status: all, open, reviewing, resolved, or dismissed. Open reports are high priority.

table.title: Report rows
table.description: Each row shows organization, category, reporter, related event, status, and date. Use Resolve to handle each report.

resolve.title: Resolve an integrity report
resolve.description: Open a dialog to update status, add resolution notes, view evidence, and optionally exclude the event from rankings.

profileTab.title: Edit organization profile
profileTab.description: Update the organization name, email, description, social links, and status. Save or suspend from this tab.

membersTab.title: Manage organization members
membersTab.description: Add members, view their permissions, set ownership, and remove users from this tab.

eventsTab.title: Review organization events
eventsTab.description: View all events belonging to this organization. Verify or unverify each event's rankings from this table.

saveProfile.title: Save profile changes
saveProfile.description: Commit edits to name, email, description, and socials after making changes on the Profile tab.

suspend.title: Suspend the organization
suspend.description: Temporarily block the organization's access without deleting it. Use Unsuspend to restore access later.

create.title: Create a new sponsor account
create.description: Set up a new sponsor account with login credentials and event assignments in a guided wizard.

search.title: Search sponsor accounts
search.description: Filter by full name, username, or email. Results update as you type.

table.title: Sponsor accounts table
table.description: Every sponsor with full name, username, email, and actions. Click Edit to update details and event assignments.

pagination.title: Navigate sponsor pages
pagination.description: Move through the sponsor list using page numbers. The table is paginated client-side.

stepIndicator.title: Two-step sponsor creation
stepIndicator.description: Step 1: Account Details with credentials. Step 2: Assign events to the sponsor account.

accountForm.title: Create account credentials
accountForm.description: Enter full name, UID, username, email, and password. Password must meet complexity requirements.

passwordStrength.title: Password strength indicator
passwordStrength.description: Shows requirements met and strength level: weak, medium, or strong.

events.title: Assign events to sponsor
events.description: Select events to grant the sponsor access. This step is optional. Skip to finish without assignment.

success.title: Account created successfully
success.description: The plaintext credentials display only once. Copy or download them immediately before closing.

details.title: Update sponsor details
details.description: Edit full name, email, and username. Optionally reset password with complexity requirements.

password.title: Reset sponsor password
password.description: Leave blank to keep current password. If changed, must meet strength requirements.

events.title: Update event assignments
events.description: Search and select which events the sponsor can access. Changes take effect immediately on save.

save.title: Save sponsor updates
save.description: Commit all changes to details and event assignments.

create.title: Create a new API key partner
create.description: Provision a new data-API partner. It starts with every toggle off and no scope until configured.

search.title: Search API key partners
search.description: Filter by name or slug. Results update as you type.

table.title: API key partners table
table.description: Each partner shows name, slug, status, active key count, and creation date. Click name to configure.

activeKeys.title: Active API keys count
activeKeys.description: Shows how many active (non-revoked) keys are issued for each partner.

pagination.title: Navigate partner pages
pagination.description: Move through the partners list using page numbers. Server-side paginated.

profileTab.title: Partner profile and suspension
profileTab.description: View name and contact email (read-only). Use Suspend to block all keys at once without revoking.

scopeTab.title: Configure scope and toggles
scopeTab.description: Grant access to native AFC events, specific events, organizations, and configure 6 resource and 8 field toggles.

keysTab.title: Manage API keys
keysTab.description: Issue new keys with optional labels and per-key rate limits. Revoke active keys with immediate effect.

nativeAfc.title: Grant all native AFC events
nativeAfc.description: One switch grants every AFC-run event (no organizer) at once for convenience.

allowedEvents.title: Select allowed events
allowedEvents.description: Searchable list of events to grant the partner read access to.

issueKey.title: Issue a new API key
issueKey.description: Create a new key with optional label and rate limit. Plaintext is shown only once.

create.title: Create a new news article
create.description: Write and publish news with rich text, images, category, and status. Uses a stepped form.

search.title: Search news by title, content, or author
search.description: Filter articles in real-time as you type your search query.

dateFilter.title: Filter by publication date
dateFilter.description: Show only articles published on a specific date.

categoryFilter.title: Filter by category
categoryFilter.description: Categories: General News, Tournament Updates, Banned Player or Team Updates. Select one or view all.

statusFilter.title: Filter by publication status
statusFilter.description: Show Published, Draft, or Archived articles separately.

clearFilters.title: Reset all filters
clearFilters.description: Remove all active search and filter criteria to see the full news list again.

cards.title: News article cards
cards.description: Grid of article cards with image, title, author, date, and likes and dislikes. Click View to read full article.

tabsHeader.title: Switch between settings tabs
tabsHeader.description: This settings page has multiple tabs: Admin Users, All Users, Roles, Notifications, Login History and Admin Activities. Each tab controls a different aspect of user and role management.

exportExcel.title: Export administrators to Excel
exportExcel.description: Download a complete list of all administrators and their roles as an Excel file for records or reporting.

adminSearch.title: Find an administrator
adminSearch.description: Search for admin users by username, email or role. The table below updates as you type.

adminEdit.title: Edit administrator roles
adminEdit.description: Click the pencil icon next to any admin to change their assigned roles and permissions. You can combine multiple roles.

adminSuspend.title: Suspend or activate an admin
adminSuspend.description: Temporarily disable an administrator account by clicking Suspend, or re-enable a suspended account by clicking Activate.

headline.title: OCR model headline metrics
headline.description: Watch the key numbers: active model version, local share (percentage of reads answered by the local model), zero-touch rate (reads with no admin edits needed) and Gemini calls (cost proxy).

tabs.title: Explore OCR model details
tabs.description: Performance charts show how the flywheel is climbing (local model taking more reads, fewer admin edits). Dataset, Retrain History and Controls tabs hold the operator tools.

download.title: Download the training dataset
download.description: Export the current gold-label training data as a ZIP file. The offline trainer uses this to train the next model version.

promote.title: Promote a model to active
promote.description: Type the version of a trained model (for example local_student_v4) and click Promote to make it the active read engine for new screenshots.

rollback.title: Rollback to the previous model
rollback.description: If the active model has issues, click Rollback to revert to the previously promoted version until you can diagnose and promote a fix.

metrics.title: Drafted events snapshot
metrics.description: Two cards show the total number of drafted events across all admins and the number you personally created. Use these to track work in progress.

search.title: Find a draft by event name
search.description: Type an event name to filter the list below. The search works across all drafts or only your drafts, depending on the tab you have open.

tabs.title: Switch between All Drafts and My Drafts
tabs.description: The All Drafts tab shows every admin's in-progress events. My Drafts shows only the ones you created. Badges show counts.

continue.title: Continue editing a draft
continue.description: Click the Continue editing button to reopen a draft event in the wizard and pick up where you left off.

delete.title: Delete a draft event
delete.description: Click the trash icon to remove a draft. Confirmation is required. Deleting a draft does not affect published events.

metrics.title: Voting dashboard headline metrics
metrics.description: Key cards show total votes cast, unique voters, completion rate and average voting time. Watch these to track voting campaign health.

tabs.title: Explore voting data by tab
tabs.description: Tabs let you dive into Overview, Sections, Categories, Nominees, Winners, Timeline, Top Performers and Management. Each offers a different view of voting data.

sections.title: View award sections
sections.description: The Sections tab shows all award groupings (for example Content Creator Awards, Esports Awards) with vote totals and category counts for each.

categories.title: Analyze voting by category
categories.description: The Categories tab breaks down votes per award category with charts and bars. Use the section filter to focus on one award area.

winners.title: Review category winners
winners.description: The Winners tab displays the top vote-getter in each category with vote counts and percentages so you can see who is leading in real time.

header.title: The written reference
header.description: Every tour, including this one, points at controls on a live screen. This page is the version you can read away from the screen, and unlike a tour you can search it.

search.title: Search everything at once
search.description: Searching covers both views: the guides and every documented control. Type the label you saw on a button, for example Unpublish or Reseed, rather than a whole question.

areas.title: Narrow it to one area
areas.description: Events, leaderboards, teams, players, rankings, broadcasts, overlays, shop, news, sponsors, organizations, market and settings. Pick one when you already know roughly where the thing lives.

views.title: Guides or the full control list
views.description: Guides walk a whole process end to end, such as running a tournament on the day. Every control is the dictionary: what one specific button does, who can press it, and whether it changes data.

guides.title: Each guide links to the real screen
guides.description: Start here on a guide opens the screen the process begins on, and each guide has a slot ready for a video walkthrough to be added later.
